page.content:
Ibis scribe of the gods who records the judgment.

How Thoth connects

  • Event: Weighing of the heart — Thoth records the outcome of the weighing.
  • Artifact: Eye of Horus — Thoth restored the Eye of Horus after Set wounded it.

What is Thoth?

Thoth invented writing and magic, mediates between Horus and Set, and stands by the scales to write whether the dead has spoken truly.

Key threads lead to Weighing of the heart and Eye of Horus.
